rendering_findings.rationale: The multiplication is not enclosed in its own opening and closing display delimiters: line 30 closes its display before the prose “with the product topology and multiplication”, line 31 supplies the equation without an opener, and line 32 is a stray closer. The local HTML capture records a KaTeX parse error for the paragraph and the PNG visibly substitutes a red error block. The intended group law is (v,t)(w,s)=(v+w,t+s−½ω(v,w)).
rendering_findings.suggested_source_shape: Keep the group definition inline or display it separately, then wrap the multiplication on line 31 in a matched `$$ ... $$` block. Preserve the topology statement outside math.

rendering_findings.rationale: The receipt and local HTML show “diagram failed to render” for the central-extension diagram. Its mathematical data is exact: 1 → R → H(V,ω) → V → 1, with j(t)=(0,t) and pr_V(v,t)=v. The map pr_V is surjective with kernel j(R), whose image is the stated center.
rendering_findings.draw_or_check: Render the row `1 → ℝ --j--> H(V,ω) --pr_V--> V → 1`, labeling j(t)=(0,t) and pr_V(v,t)=v. Check exactness from ker(pr_V)={(0,t):t∈ℝ}=j(ℝ); no proof should depend on the diagram.

rendering_findings.rationale: Line 53 appends the literal `## Sources` heading and citation to the end of proof step 2.1. The local HTML and screenshot consequently render the source citation as part of the proof paragraph instead of as a distinct section.
rendering_findings.suggested_source_shape: End proof step 2.1 after “supplies strong continuity and unitarity.” Then put `## Sources` on a new line after a blank line and place the citation below it.
